ms.report:
Updated: Swap contract link since last submission, thanks!
For this milestone, the Charli3 team needed to create test cases, run and complete those tests, conduct an internal audit to identify issues and provide remedies. Additionally, the milestone requires we specify a partner or dummy use-case for launching the fourth milestone on mainnet. We've decided on the dummy use-case (details below). 
The PDF Internal Audit Report below presents screenshots and details of our test cases, showing them passing/completed, and remedies for any issues found during the process. 
Outputs:
・INTERNAL AUDIT/TEST CASES/REMEDIES: Click here to download a PDF Internal Audit Report; https://drive.google.com/file/d/1WMLlFjnOGMU0Z7VOaLEYUoaG4amuRG7N/view?usp=sharing
・DUMMY USE-CASE: Dummy use-case for Final Milestone (this was already presented in milestone 3 and we plan to launch this on mainnet for the next milestone -- we are in discussions with a partner that may replace the dummy example, but for all intents and purposes this is the use case that will be the final output for this project): A sample contract provides funds and data requirements to a wallet that initiates a C3 Network to pull data from sources as per requirements and put them on-chain.
